description: This file defines Backbone.js models, collections, views, and router for a Todo application, including the Todo model, collection, item view, router, and main application view, with initialization code to start the app.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: A Backbone model representing a single todo item with default attributes, toggle, initialize, and clear methods.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: A Backbone collection of Todo models, backed by localStorage, with methods for filtering completed and remaining todos, and determining the next order.

classes.name: TodoView
classes.description: A Backbone view for individual todo items, handling rendering, toggling completion, editing, and removal.

classes.name: TodoRouter
classes.description: A Backbone router managing URL routes for filtering todos.

classes.name: AppView
classes.description: The main application view managing the overall Todo app UI, including rendering, event handling, and initializing the router.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns default attributes for a Todo model.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a Todo model, ensuring it has a title.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the 'completed' state of a Todo.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the Todo model.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Filters and returns completed todos.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Filters and returns remaining (not completed) todos.

methods.name: nextOrder
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for new todos.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Defines sorting order based on 'order' attribute.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Todo item view.

methods.name: toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of the Todo.

methods.name: toggleVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the Todo view based on filter.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Switches the view into editing mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves or removes the Todo when editing is finished.

methods.name: updateOnEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key to finish editing.

methods.name: revertOnEscape
methods.description: Reverts changes on Escape key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the Todo model.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the current filter for displaying todos.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main app view, including stats and filters.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Adds a single Todo item view to the list.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all Todo items to the list.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sets the current filter criteria.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers visibility update for a Todo.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filter to all Todos.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates attributes for a new Todo.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new Todo when Enter is pressed.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed Todos.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Marks all Todos as completed or active.
